name: Demon
fantasy: A horned, winged brute of charcoal hide with magma burning through the cracks. Cracks the ground with his fists, charges through his foes on a trail of lava, hurls molten boulders and calls meteors down from the pit.

directions.name: Magma
directions.desc: The fists and the charge: Molten Fists, Infernal Charge and raw fury.

directions.name: Cataclysm
directions.desc: The ground torn open: Infernal Charge, Fault of the Pit and Brimstone Hurl.

directions.name: The Pit
directions.desc: What the pit gives: Hellgrip, Wrath of the Pit and charcoal hide.

skills.name: Molten Fists
skills.desc: A slow, heavy two-fisted blow: your fists catch fire as you draw back, then crack the ground open ahead of you. Everything in the wedge takes 300% weapon damage plus magma and is set alight. Branded enemies take 30% more and lose the Brand. Dodge to cancel it.

skills.name: Infernal Charge
skills.desc: Paw the ground, then charge head-down up to 9 metres along a burning line everyone can see. You stop on the first champion or player you hit: it takes 120% weapon damage plus magma, is staggered and Branded. Lesser monsters are bowled aside.

skills.name: Fault of the Pit
skills.desc: Slam the ground and split it in a line 7 metres long across your aim. After a glowing warning it erupts: everything on it takes 133% weapon damage plus magma, is thrown up and Branded. The fault stays molten for 4 seconds: crossing it burns and slows by 35%.

skills.name: Brimstone Hurl
skills.desc: Tear a molten boulder out of the ground and lob it up to 14 metres; its shadow shows where it will land. A direct hit (1.3 metres) deals 77% weapon damage plus magma and Brands; the edge (2.6 metres) half. No cooldown: throw again as soon as the throw is done. It shatters into burning shards.

skills.name: Hellgrip
skills.desc: Hurl a molten chain with an iron claw 7.5 metres: the first enemy it hooks is dragged to you, hoisted and smashed into the ground for 320% weapon damage plus magma. Bosses drag you to them instead. A Branded target gives back 30% of the cooldown.

skills.name: Wrath of the Pit
skills.desc: Fold your wings round you for up to 2 seconds (press again to end it early): you take 50% less damage, can't be stunned or moved, and store the damage as heat. Then burst out: everything within 6 metres takes 100% weapon damage plus the stored heat (up to 30% of your life), is hurled back and frozen with fear. For 6 seconds you deal +40% damage and meteors rain on the enemies round you.

skills.name: Volcano
skills.desc: Tear open a volcano at the pointer: it hurls five meteors onto the foes around it over two seconds, each 110% weapon damage and setting them alight.

skills.name: Hellbrand Detonation
skills.desc: Every Branded foe within 10 metres erupts: 160% weapon damage, thrown up for 0.8 seconds, and the fire bursts onto those beside it. The Brands are spent.

skills.name: Blood Pact
skills.desc: Pay 15% of your life to the pit: for 8 seconds +35% damage and 6% of the damage you deal heals you.
